text:
Olivia: Heads up  three onsite interviewers today couldn't submit scorecards from their phones. They clicked the calendar "submit score" link and got a 401 token expired error. Reported by recruiter at 09:40.

Ben: which candidates/panels?

Olivia: C-7781, C-7783, C-7790. All panels had onsite start times within the last 48h; interviewers tried to submit after a lunch break.

Katherine: I pulled the invite link flow  the calendar invites include a one-time submit token param like `?tkn=abc` that our mobile shortlink service validates. Token TTL was recently reduced in the security-hardening change from 7d -> 12h. That change landed last week.

Samir: Ah. We tightened TTL to limit replay attacks but didn't coordinate with recruiting. For in-person onsite flows, interviewers often submit hours later; 12h is too short.

Ben: Short-term workaround: recruiters can copy the candidate ID and use the web portal (SSO) to open the candidate page and submit. Not great for onsite panel flow.

Katherine: I can add a fast revert: update the token TTL for submit links back to 7d for calendar-generated tokens only, while keeping 12h for other short-lived flows. ETA 90m with audit log.

Olivia: That would help. Also need to fix any invites that already have expired tokens for panels within last 72h.

Samir: I'll write a backfill script to reissue new submit tokens and patch invites for affected panels. Plan: query invites where `invite.generated_at > now - 72h` and `token.expired=true`, create new tokens and update calendar event URL. I'll run in staging first.

Ben: Can we also add a button in the calendar invite that points to the SSO portal fallback so interviewers can hit SSO if token fails? Minimal UX change.

Katherine: Good idea  I'll add `submit_via_portal` fallback link to invite template. No infra deploy needed, just template update.

recruiter-bot: For backfill runs open ticket with Subject "Backfill: InviteTokenRefresh" and include panel IDs and runbook. Use priority P2.

Olivia: I'll coordinate with recruiting to inform affected interviewers and provide the portal fallback steps. Please DM me PR/patch when ready.

Samir: Posting PR + runbook in 60m. Will run backfill after approvals.

Katherine: After immediate fix, let's add a deploy checklist item: any security TTL changes that affect user-facing tokens must be communicated to recruiting and have a 48h grace window.

Ben: Agreed. Also monitoring: add a metric "submit_token_expiry_count" and an alert when >5 in 1h.

ops-bot: Action items: Katherine (TTL revert + invite template fallback), Samir (backfill script + run), Olivia (comms + ticket), Ben (monitoring). Reopen if anything fails. :thumbsup:
